name: RunJavaScriptFunctionOnWebPage
label: Run JavaScript Function on Web Page
description: Executes a custom JavaScript function in the context of the current web page.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: JavaScriptFunction
fields.label: JavaScript Function
fields.description: The JavaScript function to execute (e.g., 'document.getElementById("myId").value = "test";' or 'return document.title')

fields.name: ScriptArguments
fields.label: Arguments
fields.description: Optional arguments to pass to the script function.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for script execution before failing.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result Output
fields.description: Returns the result of the JavaScript execution, if any.
